judged_text: isTeamAdminOrOwner is computed with && between isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner, so it is only true for users who are simultaneously admin AND owner, and the permission check falls through for plain admins or owners. A team admin (but not owner) or owner (but not admin) attempting to add guests to their team's booking is denied with FORBIDDEN even though the code clearly intends 'admin or owner' to be an authorized role; the condition is also evaluated twice with two separate awaits instead of one role query.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both admin AND owner. The subsequent permission gate `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee)` will therefore reject a plain team admin or a plain team owner (who is neither organizer nor attendee) with `FORBIDDEN`, despite the variable name and typical authorization intent implying admin OR owner. This logic is introduced by the diff and is verifiably incorrect/overly restrictive. It also performs two separate awaited role checks.
